svg.title: Microbiologist — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as microbiologist, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: One open Petri dish contains a curved bacterium and two separate round microbial colonies. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
